## Goal

## Scope

Identify affected components and the intended behavior change.

## Non-goals

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe measurable outcomes, including relevant failure cases.

## Dependencies and parent Epic

Link blocking issues (or write None). Link the required parent Epic labeled
`type:epic`, attach this issue as its direct native GitHub sub-issue, and add
it to the Epic's child checklist. Verify the parent, its label, and the checklist;
a body link alone does not establish membership. If the appropriate Epic is
unclear, ask before choosing or creating one.

## Size and priority

Propose micro/small size and high/normal/low priority with rationale.
If the work cannot be bounded to micro/small, split it before automated pickup.

## Validation

List relevant existing checks and any required manual evidence.

## Decisions and authorization

Record agreed decisions, tradeoffs, required human access, and unresolved questions.
Only a human may approve the current scope and mark it `status:ready`.
Submitting this template does not authorize an agent to begin work.
